<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_ready">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">State DIVIDE.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]" description="Counter for division iterations."/>
        <reg id="start_cnt" description="Flag to indicate the start of division process."/>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg" description="Register to hold the result validity flag."/>
        <reg id="res_ready_reg" description="Register to hold the result readiness flag."/>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[7:0]" description="Negative value of the divisor for subtraction."/>
        <reg id="remainder" width_description="[7:0]" description="Remainder of the division operation."/>
        <reg id="quotient" width_description="[7:0]" description="Quotient of the division operation."/>
        <reg id="SR" width_description="[15:0]" description="Shift Register for storing the dividend during division."/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
            // Reset condition
            if (!rst) begin
                // Initialize registers to default values
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                res_ready_reg <= 1'b0;
                neg_divisor <= 8'h00;
                remainder <= 8'h00;
                quotient <= 8'h00;
                SR <= 16'h0000;
            end else begin
                // Check if opn_valid is high and res_valid is low
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                    // Save dividend and divisor
                    dividend_save <= dividend;
                    divisor_save <= divisor;
                    
                    // Shift dividend left by one bit and store it in SR
                    SR <= {dividend[7], dividend} << 1;
                    
                    // Calculate negative divisor
                    neg_divisor <= ~divisor + 1;
                    
                    // Set counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1
                    cnt <= 4'd1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end
                
                // Division process
                if (start_cnt) begin
                    // Check if counter cnt is equal to 8
                    if (&cnt) begin
                        // Clear counter cnt and start_cnt
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        
                        // Update shift register SR with remainder and quotient
                        SR <= {remainder, quotient};
                    end else begin
                        // Increment counter cnt
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        
                        // Perform subtraction operation
                        {carry_out, remainder} <= SR[15:8] + neg_divisor;
                        
                        // Multiplexer to select between remainder and SR[15:8]
                        if (carry_out) begin
                            quotient <= SR[15:8];
                        end else begin
                            quotient <= remainder;
                        end
                        
                        // Shift right operation
                        SR <= {carry_out, SR[15:9]};
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block
        always @(*) begin
            // Default assignment for res_valid_reg
            res_valid_reg = 1'b0;
            
            // Check if counter cnt is equal to 8
            if (&cnt) begin
                // Set res_ready_reg to 1
                res_ready_reg = 1'b1;
                
                // Check if res_ready is high
                if (res_ready) begin
                    // Set res_valid_reg to 0
                    res_valid_reg = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            
            // Assign res_valid_reg to res_valid
            res_valid = res_valid_reg;
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
